name: Patient check-in (FHIR)
note: Requires a FHIR connector configured in the workspace AND backend PR #450 (call_id stash fix) deployed. Uses the test patient David C Ali / 1965-09-18 — replace with a patient that exists in your connected EHR.

turns.say: Hi, I'm calling to do my post-discharge check-in.
My full name is David C Ali, date of birth September 18th, 1965.
Can you tell me what medications I'm currently prescribed? I forgot.
I've been feeling a bit dizzy since yesterday.
No, no other symptoms — just the dizziness. That's all.
